description:
Stand Out With Custom Die-Cut Postcard Printing


Give your postcards a bold new look with custom die-cut shapes. Whether you're going for sharp angles, soft curves, or a completely custom outline, these cards help you capture attention from the first glance. Choose from preset shapes or upload your own, then finish strong with foil, gloss, or textured upgrades. Perfect for creatives, product launches, or anyone who wants to make a unique introduction.

Custom Shapes That Make a Statement

Custom Die-Cut Shapes
Foil and Specialty Finish Options
Durable Cardstock Choices
Choose from leaf, oval, circle, rounded corners, or your own shape Nine foil colors including gold, silver, copper, black, and pearl Printed on thick 14 pt., fine grit 16 pt., or ultra-thick 17 pt. stock
Unique silhouettes help your brand stand out Raised Spot UV adds texture and contrast Built to last and impress
Perfect for creative professionals and bold branding Gloss or matte finishes available Supports one-sided or two-sided printing

Order a Postcard That Fits Your Vision





Multiple Die-Cut Shapes

Pick from preset templates or upload your own custom silhouette.

Nine Foil Color Options

Choose from bold or subtle metallics to highlight logos or key details.

Raised Spot UV Available

If you want depth and contrast to make your postcard stand out, choose Raised Spot UV, where only a specific area is coated.

Gloss, Matte, or Silk Lamination

Choose your finish based on your design and tactile preferences.

Rounded Corners Optional

Soften the look with a modern, curved finish.



Die-Cut Postcards FAQs

Q: Can I upload my own shape design?

Yes. You can upload a custom die line file for production. Just follow our template guidelines to ensure proper bleeds and margins.

Q: What is the difference between foil and Spot UV?

Foil adds a colored metallic layer to your design. Spot UV adds clear gloss to selected areas for contrast and texture.

Q: What paper options are available for die-cut cards?

We offer 14 pt., fine grit 16 pt., and ultra-thick 17 pt. cardstock to suit different styles and use cases.
